source_cause: Lake installs a real ActorFrame DrawFunction, but live advancement never calls the owned draw traversal. Native GameLoop updates the complete screen then draws it; ScreenManager skips a replacement before its first update and does not draw a popped scene.
change: Separate owned scene update and draw, with advance providing both for a still active scene. Production gameplay draws after its full update and life visuals, after processing navigation/reload boundaries. Native draw callback phase, nested explicit Draw, current tween poses and inherited visibility/opacity are honored. Draw-queued commands remain pending until the next actor update. Live draw capture stores only the current frame; compiler baked history is preserved.
screen_lifetime: Draw skips scenes before their first update and after End. Production skips outgoing navigation/reload frames without using native expected timestamps. A new screen request authored during draw is processed after the next update; transition-out starts during that draw and advances on following updates.
regression_control: An owned root originally reproduced zero draw callbacks instead of one. Its strengthened control covers update and health before draw, explicit nested Draw, replacement of automatic children, deferred queued commands, split update/draw, visibility, hibernation, zero diffuse alpha and glow, wrapper visibility, callback removal/replacement, draw-time visual pose writes, 2000 subsequent frames with one current draw frame/one leaf and <8192 retained bytes, and no draw after End.
